data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for displaying incoming call screens when the app is in the background or terminated.
data.what_it_does: It handles displaying native incoming call screens on Android and iOS when push notifications arrive. It provides tokens (FCM/VoIP) and listens to user actions such as accept, reject, and mute.
use_when: You are building a VoIP or calling app and need native background incoming call interfaces.
You need to handle push notifications specifically tailored for audio or video calls on Android and iOS.
avoid_when: You only need generic local or push notifications without native call screen UI.
You are not building a calling or real-time communication application.
strengths: Supports native background/terminated incoming call screens for both Android and iOS.
Built-in token handling for FCM and VoIP notifications.
Allows customization of ringtones, icons, and accent colors.
weaknesses: Requires specific platform-level configurations like Google Services or Info.plist modifications.
Platform behavior differs significantly between Android and iOS regarding terminated state handlers.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding google-services.json and build.gradle setup on Android, and UIBackgroundModes remote-notification and voip in Info.plist on iOS.
